Welcome to this spacious 2 Bed 2 Bath home at Highbury Place, conveniently located near Alma Street and West 8th Avenue on Vancouver’s West Side. Over 1,000 sq ft of living space, a functional layout, and bedrooms separated for added privacy, this home is a great fit for professionals, couples, or small families looking for space and convenience.

Home Highlights

✔ 2 Bedrooms + 2 Bathrooms
✔ Approx. 1,046 sq ft of living space
✔ Functional and spacious layout
✔ Separated bedrooms for added privacy
✔ Cozy fireplace in the living room
✔ Good-sized private balcony
✔ In-suite laundry
✔ 1 parking stall included
✔ 1 storage locker included
✔ Unfurnished
✔ Move-in ready

Enjoy easy access to neighbourhood shops, restaurants, parks, and transit, with UBC just a short commute away:

Local cafés, restaurants and shops along West Broadway and Alma Street within walking distance
Almond Park and McBride Park ~4 min walk
Jericho Beach ~10 min drive
West Point Grey Community Centre ~5 min drive
University of British Columbia (UBC) ~10 min drive
Pacific Spirit Regional Park ~10 min drive
Kitsilano shops and restaurants ~10 min drive
Downtown Vancouver ~15-20 min drive

School Catchment

Bayview Community Elementary
Kitsilano Secondary

Rental Details

* Available November 1
* Minimum one-year lease
* Credit check required
* Reference check required
* Tenant insurance required
* No pets
* No smoking

Location: 203-3720 W 8th Avenue, Vancouver, BC

How to Inquire

To arrange a viewing, please include:

* A brief introduction about yourself
* Your ideal move-in date
* Whether you will be living alone or with another occupant
* Whether you have a pet
* Your availability to view the unit
